title: Your typical day
prompt_seed: Get the student talking about their daily routine — when they wake up, how they get to work or school, what they do in the evening. Ask about small concrete details rather than generalities.

title: Where you grew up
prompt_seed: Ask about the student's hometown: what it looks like, what it is known for, how it has changed, whether they would move back.

title: Food and cooking
prompt_seed: Talk about food — what they ate today, dishes from their region, whether they cook, a meal they would recommend to a visitor.

title: Weekends and free time
prompt_seed: Ask what the student does with their free time, what last weekend looked like, and what they wish they had more time for.

title: Work and career
prompt_seed: Explore the student's job: what they actually do day to day, what is hard about it, where they want to be in a few years.

title: Travel and places
prompt_seed: Talk about a trip the student has taken or wants to take. Push for narrative — what happened, what went wrong, what surprised them.

title: Technology in daily life
prompt_seed: Discuss how technology shows up in the student's life — apps they rely on, something that frustrates them, whether they think it helps or distracts.

title: Job interview practice
prompt_seed: Run a light job interview. Ask one question at a time, let the student answer fully, then give a short reaction before the next question.

title: Small talk with strangers
prompt_seed: Practise social small talk — meeting someone at a conference, chatting with a taxi driver, waiting in a queue. Model natural openers and let the student respond.

title: Giving opinions and disagreeing
prompt_seed: Pick a low-stakes debatable topic and draw out the student's opinion. Push back politely so they practise defending a view and conceding a point.

title: Telling a story
prompt_seed: Get the student to tell an extended story from their life. Stay quiet and let them run; prompt only when they stall, and focus on narrative tenses.

title: Explaining your work
prompt_seed: Have the student explain something they know well to a non-expert. Ask naive follow-up questions so they practise rephrasing and simplifying.
